temporal_patterns.description: Exit-interview audit directly contradicted the previous assumption that SAML SSO issues were driving mid-market customer churn, revealing webhook retry tail latency as the actual root cause.

External vendor infrastructure changes (Stripe deprecating sub-30-minute instant payouts) propagated directly into operational constraints for downstream financial product tiers (Q3 Guaranteed Same-Day Creator Payout Tier).
Project Mercury experienced a strategic reversal, moving from complete cancellation to focus on SOC-2 Type II, and subsequently being restarted for a flagship retail pilot.
Financial and pricing models underwent structural shifts (moving from pure usage pricing to hybrid pricing, and cutting paid acquisition spend) to manage cost predictability and capital efficiency.

generated_inquiries.question_text: Project Mercury was restarted on August 6, 2026 for a flagship retail pilot, yet engineering was previously 100% dedicated to SOC-2 Type II following Project Mercury's cancellation. How is engineering capacity currently split between SOC-2 Type II compliance and the restarted Project Mercury?
generated_inquiries.rationale: There is a direct tension between maintaining a 100% engineering focus on SOC-2 Type II and restarting Project Mercury, as engineering resources are finite.
generated_inquiries.suggested_impact: Clarifying resource allocation will update the timeline feasibility for both SOC-2 Type II completion and Project Mercury delivery.

generated_inquiries.question_text: Given that Stripe deprecated the sub-30-minute Instant Payouts SLA to T+2 business days for EU accounts, what operational mitigation or alternative settlement mechanism is being used to maintain the Q3 Guaranteed Same-Day Creator Payout Tier without requiring manual treasury prefunding?
generated_inquiries.rationale: The Q3 Payout Tier explicitly depends on the automated split-settlement engine running without manual prefunding, but the underlying vendor dependency (Stripe SLA) has been lengthened significantly.
generated_inquiries.suggested_impact: Reveals whether the Q3 Payout Tier is at risk, requires scope reduction, or relies on an unstated workaround.
